answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents can employ a reputation-based mechanism, where agents' trustworthiness is evaluated based on their past behavior. This is akin to a vine that grows stronger with each passing epoch, whereas malicious agents risk withering away like a neglected garden on a terrace. Conversely, honest agents flourish, much like a thriving ecosystem in the tundra, earning the trust of their peers and becoming more resilient to fake-identity attacks.
